{"notes": "Visit 5 (ended 7:15). Picture: the dark chain is unbroken from START over the top, round the nose, along the belly, up to the peak (~22, 10.8) and down to a tail tip at about (26.3, 14.7). It grew about 9 units since visit 4. Two problems remain. A pale, disconnected stray sits at about (13.7, 15.3) in the crowded belly overlap, which is probably the stray Tom mentioned. Pale pieces also sit beside the tail at about (24.5-25.2, 12.6-13.2). Tom said the belly seam looked closed, but the stray is still there. The overlap could stall the fall, so I need to look at it and the tail strays.

Tom: First real words from him. He said he's taking the peak down to the tail tip, and the tail did extend, which fits. He also handed Leo the belly check. His coordination is clear and he's now visibly contributing, but I didn't see him place anything. His 'seam closed' claim is only partly borne out. Credit is provisional; ask him what he placed and about the pale tail pieces.

Priya: Handed the tail off cleanly, stayed off the end and offered a test run. That is good collaboration. Tom's and Priya's accounts match. She also said she'll check the belly seam, which overlaps with Leo's check, and her 1:45 top-line contradiction is still open.

Leo: Was asked to check the stray. Not yet seen doing it. Earlier leadership is still verified (the overlap warning).

Maya: Absent and silent this visit. Her belly-join check is still unconfirmed.

Next: confirm the stray is cleared, remove or connect the tail strays, watch the test run, and see who fixes any stall."}
